items.title: 15.7.1 Addiction, Tolerance and Withdrawal Symptoms (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of addiction, tolerance and withdrawal (PDF 47-48).

items: Dependence (inhisar): aisi halat jis mein insan kaam karne ke liye jismani ya jazbati taur par dawa par munhasir ho. Psychoactive drugs ka ghalat istemal aksar is tak le jata hai.
Addiction (lat): nuqsan ke bawajood dawa ki be-qaboo talab aur istemal ki bimari; dependence aksar addiction ban jati hai.
Tolerance: musalsal istemal se jism dhal kar kam hassas ho jata hai, to wahi asar ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye, jo lat barhati hai.
Withdrawal symptoms: dawa chhorne par aadi shakhs ko hone wali alamaat, jaise ulti, sar dard, be-khwabi, saans ki takleef, udasi, zehni be-qarari aur dauray.

blocks.text: Nasha-awar dawayein dimagh ke un hisson par asar karti hain jo lutf aur hosla-afzai qaboo karte hain. Wahan presynaptic neurons dopamine chhorte hain jo khushi aur inaam ka ehsas deta hai. Kitab batati hai ke dawa ke molecules presynaptic neuron mein dopamine ki wapsi rok dete hain, to dopamine cleft mein jama hota hai; dimagh postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam kar ke dhalta hai, yahi tolerance hai. Dawa achanak band ho to dopamine ka ikhraj naarmal ho jata magar kam receptors ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam jagta hai, aur withdrawal ki alamaat aati hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar chhote synapses saath saath. Normal: cleft mein dopamine ke nuqte, neeche paanch receptors aur terminal par naranji reuptake pump. Drug li gayi: pump band (kaala, surkh X) aur cleft mein bohat zyada dopamine. Tolerance: pump ab bhi band magar sirf do receptors. Withdrawal: pump chal raha, dopamine naarmal, magar receptors ab bhi do.
blocks.caption: Dawa ke istemal, lat, tolerance aur withdrawal mein asabi tabdeeliyan (Figure 15.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nasha-awar dawayein dimagh ke lutf aur hosla-afzai wale hisson par asar karti hain. In synapses par chhoota dopamine khushi aur inaam ka ehsas deta hai; drug us ki wapsi (reabsorption) rok deti hai, to dopamine cleft mein jama hota hai. Dimagh postsynaptic neuron par dopamine receptors kam kar ke dhal jata hai, yahi tolerance hai: wahi asar ke liye zyada khuraak chahiye. Drug achanak band ho to dopamine naarmal ho jata magar kam receptors ki wajah se postsynaptic neuron kam jagta hai, aur withdrawal ki alamaat aati hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Dopamine ki wapsi rokna cocaine ka tareeqa hai; doosri nasha-awar dawayein doosre tareeqon se dopamine barhati hain (maslan opioids endorphin receptors ke zariye), is liye kitab ka tareeqa saada kiya hua hai. Kitab yeh bhi likhti hai ke nicotine receptors 'dopamine chhorte hain'; dar asal yeh receptors rakhne wale neurons jag kar dopamine chhorte hain.

blocks.prompt: Roz coffee peene wale ko coffee ke baghair din sar dard kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Musalsal caffeine se tolerance paida ho chuki hai; caffeine achanak band hone par sar dard aur thakan jaisi withdrawal alamaat aati hain.

items: Dependence, addiction, tolerance (zyada khuraak), withdrawal (chhorne par alamaat).
Dopamine jama, receptors kam (tolerance), chhorne par kam jagna (withdrawal); caffeine adenosine rokta; nicotine dopamine chhurwata hai.
